newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-SPARTAK MAINTAIN SLIM LEAD IN RUSSIAN LEAGUE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SPARTAK MAINTAIN SLIM LEAD IN RUSSIAN LEAGUE.

text.p: Defending champions Spartak Moscow maintained a slim lead at the top of the Russian league despite losing two points in Yaroslavl where they were held to a 1-1 draw on Wednesday.
Russian international midfielder Dmitry Aleinichev saved the day for the Muscovites when he equalised against Shinnik late in the game.
Spartak still head the league table on 38 points after 19 games with cross-town rivals Dynamo two points back.
Dynamo failed to take advantage of Spartak's slip when they were held to a scoreless draw by mid-table Zenit St Petersburg in Moscow.
Rotor Volgograd, who after three straight losses redeemed themselves in front of an 18,000 home crowd by beating KamAZ Naberezhnie Chelny 3-1, stay a close third with 34 points.
In Vladikavkaz, last year's runners-up Alania beat CSKA Moscow 3-0 thanks to Bakhva Tedeev's hat-trick.
